sectors.name: Għar Ħasan
sectors.description: Placeholder sector description. Two or three sentences on the character of the rock, the style of climbing, and any history worth knowing. Globigerina limestone with pockets and rounded breaks; steep near the cave mouth, slabbier as you walk east. Dries fast after rain but goes greasy in the afternoon sun from May onwards.
sectors.approach: Placeholder approach notes. From the parking area, follow the track south past the chapel for roughly 300m, then drop left down the stepped path towards the cave mouth. Ten to twelve minutes at a walk. The last thirty metres are loose — go one at a time if there is a group.
sectors.parking: Placeholder parking notes. Room for six or seven cars on the gravel pull-in at the end of the surfaced road. Do not block the farm gate. No shade, no facilities, nearest water is in Birżebbuġa.

boulders.name: Test Boulder
boulders.description: Placeholder boulder description. Flat platform above the main path with two short problems and a good warm-up traverse. Shade all afternoon.
